_note: EXAMPLE ONLY — Trimegisto does not read this file. The real config is created automatically at ~/.pi/agent/trimegisto/config.json (or via /tmg config). Copy the structure below to that file if you want to pre-configure tiers. Model values are placeholders: use any 'provider/model' id from your pi model registry, or point at a local server (ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp, ...) as a custom provider. compactionThreshold: 0 (default) = off, pi's native setting decides; 50-95 forces proactive compaction at that % of context.

watchdog._note: All values in SECONDS. 0 disables that watchdog. maxRuntimeSeconds defaults to 0 (disabled): agents that keep making progress have no wall-clock cap.

loopSupervisor._note: Swarm guard. turnLimitEnabled defaults to false: the turn limit is OFF unless you turn it on. When enabled, an agent is warned at maxAgentTurns (50) and hard-killed at maxAgentTurns + turnLimitGrace (65).

modelHealth._note: Circuit breaker for model-level failures (400 invalid_request_error, 5xx, quota, timeouts). After failureThreshold consecutive model-level failures, spawns on that model are refused for cooldownSeconds (doubling per re-trip up to maxCooldownSeconds) until it succeeds again, the model is changed in /tmg config, or /tmg reset-models clears it.
